sources.note: Negation with nicht and kein across cases and sentence positions.

sources.title: Lingolia — Sentence Structure (search snippet)
sources.note: Overview of German Wortstellung in main clauses, negation, questions, and dependent clauses.

sources.note: Self-practice exercise structures for negation with nicht and kein.

sources.title: W3C WAI WCAG 2.1 Technique H44: Using label elements to associate text labels with form controls

sources.title: W3C WAI WCAG 2.1 Technique G85: Providing a text description when user input falls outside the required format or values
sources.note: Clear diagnostic text descriptions and corrective examples when learner responses contain errors (WCAG 3.3.1, 3.3.3).

sources.title: Lingolia — Sentence Structure – Word Order in German Grammar
sources.note: German word order rules across main clauses, negation, questions, and dependent clauses.

sources.title: Lingolia — Nicht and Kein – Negation in German Grammar
sources.note: Placement of nicht (end of simple clause, before full verb in compound tenses, before prepositional/adverbial phrases) and declension of kein.

sources.title: Lingolia — Questions in German Grammar
sources.note: Closed questions (Entscheidungsfragen, verb-first), open W-questions (Ergänzungsfragen, W-word + V2), wo(r)+preposition, and indirect questions (verb-final).

sources.title: Duden — Korrektur

sources.title: Duden — Dialog
sources.note: der Dialog, Plural die Dialoge — abwechselnd geführte Rede und Gegenrede; einen Dialog führen.

sources.note: das Selbststudium — Wissensaneignung allein durch Lehrmaterialien; sich Kenntnisse im Selbststudium aneignen.

sources.note: die Berichtigung, Plural die Berichtigungen — das Richtigstellen, Verbessern; Korrektur.
